name: doorman
description: Doorman for Mac — local-first token usage, Security Radar and event ledger for AI coding agents. 100% local: nothing leaves the machine.
author: Pinata

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run icons && npm run brand && npm run runtime && npm run vsix && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run icons && npm run renderer:min && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run compile && npm run icons && npm run renderer:min && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:win: npm run compile && npm run icons && npm run renderer:min && electron-builder --win
